**This document analyzes Dnmt3aR878H in the HSC population, using data generated by Shalmali Pendse.**

---

# **PART 1 - Required Packages**

First, check the Seurat version to ensure that you begin the analysis using a version < 5.0, as this is a requirement 
of one of the steps. Please consult the README.txt file for more details.

# **PART 2 - Loading Dataset from Trailmaker**

Trailmaker already performs the filtering. In our case, there is no need to be more rigorous with the parameters.

```{r all-samples, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
mtx_path   <- list.files("counts/all-sample/DGE_filtered/", pattern = "count_matrix\\.mtx(\\.gz)?$",
                         full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)[1]
genes_path <- list.files("counts/all-sample/DGE_filtered/", pattern = "all_genes\\.csv(\\.gz)?$",
                         full.names = TRUE,recursive = TRUE)[1]
meta_path  <- list.files("counts/all-sample/DGE_filtered/", pattern = "cell_metadata\\.csv(\\.gz)?$",
                         full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)[1]

stopifnot(!is.na(mtx_path), !is.na(genes_path), !is.na(meta_path))

con <- if (grepl("\\.gz$", mtx_path)) gzfile(mtx_path) else mtx_path
mat <- readMM(con)
mat <- as(mat, "dgCMatrix")

# Read gene names
genes_df <- suppressMessages(read_csv(genes_path, guess_max = 1e6))
gene_col <- intersect(names(genes_df), c(
  "gene_name","symbol","Gene","gene","GeneName","geneSymbol","gene_symbol","V2"
))[1] %||% names(genes_df)[min(2, ncol(genes_df))]
gene_names <- make.unique(as.character(genes_df[[gene_col]]))

meta_df <- suppressMessages(read_csv(meta_path, guess_max = 1e6))
barcode_col <- intersect(tolower(names(meta_df)),
                         c("cell","cell_id","cellid","barcode","barcodes","cell_barcode","cellbarcode"))[1]
if (is.na(barcode_col)) {
  barcode_col <- names(meta_df)[1]
} else 
{
  barcode_col <- names(meta_df)[match(barcode_col, tolower(names(meta_df)))]  
}

barcodes <- as.character(meta_df[[barcode_col]])

# Label matrix & fix orientation if needed (genes x cells) 
if (length(gene_names) == nrow(mat) && length(barcodes) == ncol(mat)) {
  rownames(mat) <- gene_names; colnames(mat) <- barcodes
} else if (length(gene_names) == ncol(mat) && length(barcodes) == nrow(mat)) {
  mat <- t(mat); rownames(mat) <- gene_names; colnames(mat) <- barcodes
} else {
  stop("Dimension mismatch: check that all_genes.csv matches rows and cell_metadata.csv has one row per cell.")
}

# Align metadata and build Seurat object
meta_df$.cell <- barcodes
rownames(meta_df) <- meta_df$.cell
meta_df <- meta_df[colnames(mat), , drop = FALSE]

obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, meta.data = meta_df, project = "Dnmt3aR878H")

table(obj@meta.data$sample)  
obj@meta.data$Condition <- "Control"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$sample %in% c("Mut_1","Mut_2","Mut_3","Mut_4"), "Condition"] <- "Dnmt3aR878H"
table(obj@meta.data$Condition) 
obj@meta.data$Condition <- factor(obj@meta.data$Condition, level=c("Control","Dnmt3aR878H"))

# Quick QC overview
obj[["mitoRatio"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, "^mt-")     
obj[["riboRatio"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, "^Rps|^Rpl")

mito <- as.data.frame(obj@meta.data) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Condition, mitoRatio)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 1, width = 0.8) +
  scale_y_sqrt(limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0.6,-1))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(1.1, 2.8), linetype='dashed',
             color=c('blue', 'red'), size=0.2)+
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

mito

ribo <- as.data.frame(obj@meta.data) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Condition, riboRatio)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 1, width = 0.8) +
  scale_y_sqrt(limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0.6,-1))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(1.2, 3), linetype='dashed',
             color=c('blue', 'red'), size=0.2)+
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

ribo
```

# **PART 3 -  Data Scale & Normalization**

```{r scale&norm, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
obj <- NormalizeData(object = obj)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(object = obj)
genes <- rownames(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(object = obj, features=genes)
obj <- RunPCA(object = obj, features = VariableFeatures(object = obj))
ElbowPlot(obj) 
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:9)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.4, cluster.name = "umap.inintegrated")
obj <- RunUMAP(object = obj, dims= 1:9, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = F, group.by = "Condition")

Idents(obj) <- "umap.inintegrated"

# Run Harmony
obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$Condition)

obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = obj, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony")
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:9)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.4, cluster.name = "Clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:9, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

# Plot UMAP
color <- c("#80B1D3", "#C6E9BD", "#EB0A75", "#FDB462", "#BEBADA", "#DC9CA5", "#8B3B99", "#FCCDE5",
           "#8DD3C7", "magenta", "#FCD738","#D8C965", "#B3DE69", "blue")

p <- Seurat::DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = TRUE, label.box = TRUE,
                pt.size = 0.95, cols = color) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p

ggsave("plots/UMAP_Harmony.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)

save(obj, file="rda/seurat_harmony.rda")
```

# **PART 4 - Cell Type Annotation**

```{r annotation, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
features <- c("Ly6a","Kit","Slamf1","Fgd5","Cd48","Cd34","Flt3","Procr","Itga2b",
              "Fcgr3","Esam","Hoxb5","Hlf","Gata1","Spi1","Vwf","Cdk6","Mllt3","Ccne1","Cdkn1a",
              "Trpc6","Mmrn1","Tgm2","Cish","Scarf1","F11r","Tie1","Rgs1","Ctla2a","Mpl","Rab37",
              "Myct1","Slc18a2","Ltb","Cd9","Angpt1","Clec12a","Cd69","Ncf1","Tyrobp","BC035044",
              "Hk3","Ccl9","Cd52","Sh2d5","F630028O10Rik","Pklr","Paqr9","Snca","Add2","Prss50",
              "Col5a1","Hba-a1","Abcg4","Smim1","Tinagl1")
           
sub <- subset(obj, features=features)

matrix <- sub@assays$RNA$scale.data
matrix <- matrix[features,]

meta <- sub@meta.data

exp <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = nrow(matrix), ncol = length(unique(meta$Clusters))))
rownames(exp) <- rownames(matrix)
colnames(exp) <- unique(meta$Clusters)

for (condition in unique(meta$Clusters)) {
  cells_in_condition <- rownames(meta)[meta$Clusters == condition]
  exp[, condition] <- rowMeans(matrix[, cells_in_condition])
}

colnames(exp) <- paste0("Cluster_", colnames(exp))
colnames(exp) <- factor(colnames(exp), levels = paste0("Cluster_", 0:12))

exp <- t(exp)

x <- rownames(exp)
numeric_part <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", x))
ordered_indices <- order(numeric_part)
exp <- exp[ordered_indices, ]

cluster <- rownames(exp)
cluster <- unique(cluster)
cluster <- factor(cluster, levels = paste0("Cluster_", 0:12))
count_cluster <- length(cluster)

getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))
cluster_colors <- getPalette(count_cluster)

list_cluster_colors <- setNames(cluster_colors, cluster)

h_clusters <- rowAnnotation(Cluster = cluster,
                            col = list(Cluster = list_cluster_colors),
                            gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 2),
                            border = TRUE)

Markers <- unique(colnames(exp))

count_markers <- length(Markers)

getPl <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set3"))

marker_colors <- getPalette(count_markers)

list_marker_colors <- setNames(marker_colors, Markers)

h_markers <- HeatmapAnnotation(Markers = Markers,
                               col = list(Markers = list_marker_colors),
                               gp = gpar(col = "black"),
                               border = TRUE)

exp2 <- t(exp)

a <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(exp2, name = "zscore",
                             cluster_rows = FALSE,
                             show_row_names = TRUE,
                             show_row_dend = FALSE,
                             show_column_dend = TRUE,
                             column_names_rot = 45, 
                             cluster_columns = TRUE,
                             show_column_names = TRUE,
                             column_names_side = "top",
                             row_names_side = "left",
                             row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),  
                             column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
                             border = TRUE,
                             layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                               v = pindex(exp2, i, j)
                               l = v > -2
                               grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", v[l]), x[l], y[l], gp = gpar(fontsize = 11))
                             })

png("plots/Cell_Type_zscore.png", width = 12, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(a)
dev.off()

```

## Cell Type Assignment

```{r assignment, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
meta <- obj@meta.data
meta$cells <- rownames(meta)
meta$Clusters <- paste0("Cluster_", meta$Clusters)

obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$cells, col.name = "cells")
obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$Clusters, col.name = "Clusters")

obj@meta.data$Score <- "Unknown"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_0", "Score"] <- "LMPP"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_1", "Score"] <- "LT-HSC"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_2", "Score"] <- "MPP2"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_3", "Score"] <- "MPP3"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_4", "Score"] <- "ST-HSC"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_5", "Score"] <- "MPP2"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_6", "Score"] <- "MPP1"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_7", "Score"] <- "MEP"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_8", "Score"] <- "CMP"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_9", "Score"] <- "CMP"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_10", "Score"] <- "GMP"
obj@meta.data[obj@meta.data$Clusters == "Cluster_11", "Score"] <- "GMP"
```

# **PART 5 - Identifying HSC Score**

Install HSCScore package following the tutorial:https://github.com/fionahamey/hscScore
Download the necessary files from here: https://zenodo.org/records/3332151

```{r HSCscore, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/parse_annotated.rda")

# Generating the file to be used as input in the HSCScore model (language: bash)
file_path <- "hscscore/model_molo_genes.txt"
genes <- scan(file_path, what = "character", sep = "\n")

mat <- as.data.frame(obj@assays$RNA$counts)
cells <- colnames(mat)
a <- mat[rownames(mat) %in% genes,]
rownames(a) <- rownames(a)

missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(a))
num_new_rows <- 4
new_rows <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow=num_new_rows, ncol=ncol(a)))
colnames(new_rows) <- colnames(a)

df <- rbind(a, new_rows)
rownames(df)[(nrow(df)-num_new_rows+1):nrow(df)] <- c("2810417H13Rik", "Fam64a", "Sgol1", "Sqrdl")

write.table(df, file = "hscscore/Dnmt3aR878H.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

After running HSCScore the output file "score.csv" will be generated. Load the score file into R to continue the analysis.
The annotation of cell types - LT-HSC; ST-HSC and MPPs - was performed in accordance with the HSCScore paper.

```{r score, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
score <- read.csv("hscscore/score_Dnmt3aR878H.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

rownames(score) <- score$X
score$X <- NULL
max(score$HSC_Score) #0.5315966
min(score$HSC_Score) #-0.007624595

score$Type <- "Unknown"
score[score$HSC_Score >= 0.3, "Type"] <- "HSC"
table(score$Type)

score$Level <- "Absent"
score[(score$HSC_Score >= 0.45 & score$Type != "Unknown"), "Level"] <- "HSC_High"
score[(score$HSC_Score < 0.45 & score$HSC_Score >= 0.35 & 
         score$Type != "Unknown"), "Level"] <- "HSC_Medium"
score[(score$HSC_Score < 0.35 & score$Type != "Unknown"), "Level"] <- "HSC_Low"
#score$cells <- rownames(score)

save(score, file="hscscore/hsc_scores_levels.rda")
```

Adding the HSC Score to the seurat object:

```{r addscore, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
meta <- obj@meta.data
meta$HSCscore <- ""
score <- score[rownames(score) %in% meta$cells,]  

meta[meta$cells %in% rownames(score), "HSCscore"] <- score$Level[rownames(score) %in% meta$cells]
meta[meta$HSCscore == "LT-HSC", "HSCscore"] <- "HSC_High"
meta[meta$HSCscore == "ST-HSC", "HSCscore"] <- "HSC_Medium"
meta[meta$HSCscore == "MPPs", "HSCscore"] <- "HSC_Low"
table(meta$HSCscore)
meta[meta$HSCscore == "Absent", "HSCscore"] <- meta$Score[meta$HSCscore == "Absent"]

obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$HSCscore, col.name = "HSCscore")
table(obj@meta.data$HSCscore)

obj@meta.data$HSCscore[!obj@meta.data$HSCscore %in% c("HSC_High","HSC_Medium","HSC_Low")] <- obj@meta.data$Score[
  !obj@meta.data$HSCscore %in% c("HSC_High","HSC_Medium","HSC_Low")]

table(obj@meta.data$HSCscore)

save(obj, file="rda/parse_annotated.rda")

# Plotting UMAP
obj@meta.data$HSCscore <- factor(obj@meta.data$HSCscore, levels = c("LT-HSC","HSC_High","ST-HSC","HSC_Medium","HSC_Low","LMPP","MPP1","MPP2","MPP3","MEP","CMP","GMP"))

p <- Seurat::DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = F, group.by = "HSCscore",pt.size = 0.35,
                cols=c("LT-HSC" = "#8DB6CD",
                       "HSC_High" = "red",
                       "ST-HSC" = "orange",
                       "HSC_Medium" = "yellow",
                       "HSC_Low" = "#1874CD",
                       "LMPP" = "#EEE5DE",
                       "MPP1" = "#008B00",
                       "MPP2" = "#EB0A75",
                       "MPP3" = "magenta",
                       "MEP" = "#836FFF",
                       "CMP" = "#B3DE69",
                       "GMP" = "gray23")) +
  ggtitle(NULL)

p

ggsave("plots/UMAP_Cell_Types_HSCscore.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)
```

## HSC Score Density Plot

```{r density, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Extract UMAP coordinates for all cells
meta <- obj@meta.data
obj@meta.data$density <- paste0(obj@meta.data$HSCscore, "_", obj@meta.data$Condition)

umap_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(obj, "umap.harmony"))
umap_coords$cell <- rownames(umap_coords)
all_coords <- merge(umap_coords, obj@meta.data, by.x = "cell", by.y="cells")

highlighted_coords <- all_coords[all_coords$HSCscore %in% 
                                   c("HSC_High"),]

high <- all_coords[all_coords$density %in% 
                     c("HSC_High_Control", "HSC_High_Dnmt3aR878H"), ]

custom_colors <- c("white", "white", "white","white", "#0000FF", "#00FF00", "#FFFF00", "#FFA500","#FF0000")

# HSC_High
h <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = all_coords, aes(x = umapharmony_1, y = umapharmony_2), 
             color = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density_2d_filled(data = high, 
                         aes(x = umapharmony_1, y = umapharmony_2, 
                             fill = as.numeric(after_stat(level))), 
                         alpha = 0.75, n = 150, h = c(1.2, 1.2), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = custom_colors) +
  labs(fill = "HSC Density") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("HSC_High")

h

ggsave("plots/UMAP_HSC_High_density.png", h, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)

# HSC_Medium
highlighted_coords <- all_coords[all_coords$HSCscore %in% 
                                   c("HSC_Medium"),]
med <- all_coords[all_coords$density %in% 
                    c("HSC_Medium_Control", "HSC_Medium_Dnmt3aR878H"), ]

custom_colors <- c("white", "white", "white", "#0000FF", "#00FF00", "#FFFF00", "#FFA500","#FF0000")

m <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = all_coords, aes(x = umapharmony_1, y = umapharmony_2), 
             color = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density_2d_filled(data = med, 
                         aes(x = umapharmony_1, y = umapharmony_2, 
                             fill = as.numeric(after_stat(level))), 
                         alpha = 0.75, n = 150, h = c(1.2, 1.2), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = custom_colors) +
  labs(fill = "HSC Density") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("HSC_Medium")

m

ggsave("plots/UMAP_HSC_Medium_density.png", m, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)

rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

# **PART 6 - Distribution Plots**

## Cluster Distribution

```{r cluster-dist, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/parse_annotated.rda")

Idents(obj) <- obj@meta.data$Clusters

cluster_stats.g <- Cluster_Stats_All_Samples(seurat_object = obj, 
                                             group.by = "Condition")
cluster_stats.g <- cluster_stats.g[-14,]

data <- cluster_stats.g[,c(1:3)]
data$Freq <- round(data$Freq, 2)
data$Cluster <- factor(data$Cluster, levels = paste0("Cluster_", 0:12))

colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Pastel1"))(26)

p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Cluster, y = Freq, fill = Cluster)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.85, stat = "identity", position = "stack",
           color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name=NULL) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Percentage (%)") +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_label(aes(y = Freq, label = paste0(Freq, "%")), 
             position = position_stack(vjust = 0.8), 
             colour = "black",
             fontface = "bold",
             size = 3.5,
             fill = "white", 
             label.size = 0.25) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12,
                                color = "black",
                                face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), 
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95"),  
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8.5, angle=45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p

rm(cluster_stats.g, colors, data, p)
```

## Cell Distribution

```{r cell-dist, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
cluster_stats.g <- Cluster_Stats_All_Samples(seurat_object = obj, 
                                             group.by = "Condition")

cluster_stats.g <- cluster_stats.g[-14,]
cluster_stats.g <- cluster_stats.g[,c(1,2,4:5)]
cluster_stats.g$Total <- (cluster_stats.g$Control + cluster_stats.g$Dnmt3aR878H)
cluster_stats.g$Number <- NULL

df <- cluster_stats.g %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Control, Dnmt3aR878H),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

df$Number <- 0
df[df$variable %in% "Control", "Number"] <- df[df$variable %in% "Control", "value"] * 100 / 
  df[df$variable %in% "Control", "Total"]

df[df$variable %in% "Dnmt3aR878H", "Number"] <- df[df$variable %in% "Dnmt3aR878H", "value"] * 100 / 
  df[df$variable %in% "Dnmt3aR878H", "Total"]

df$Number <- round(df$Number, 2)
df$Total <- NULL
df$variable <- factor(df$variable, levels=c("Control","Dnmt3aR878H"))
colnames(df)[2] <- "Condition"
df$Condition <- factor(df$Condition, levels=c("Control","Dnmt3aR878H"))
df$Cluster <- factor(df$Cluster, levels = paste0("Cluster_", 0:12))

colors = c("gray92","gray75")

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Cluster, y = Number, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.65, stat = "identity", position = "stack",
           color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0,100, by = 10)) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name=NULL) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Percentage (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12,
                                color = "black",
                                face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), 
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5,face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95"),  
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8.5, angle=45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p

rm(df, meta, colors, cluster_stats.g, p)
```

# **PART 7 - Analyzing Only LT-HSCs**

Given that the majority of HSCs with high and medium scores were distributed within the LT-HSC population (cluster 1), 
we decided to create a subset of the Seurat object to obtain only the high-confidence HSC population.

```{r LT-HSC, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
hsc <- subset(obj, subset=HSCscore %in% c("LT-HSC"))
dim(hsc) # 55487  9409

# LT-HSC Heterogeneity
hsc <- JoinLayers(hsc, assay = "RNA")

hsc <- NormalizeData(
  object = hsc,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000)

hsc <- ScaleData(hsc, features=rownames(hsc))
hsc <- RunPCA(hsc)
ElbowPlot(hsc,ndims = 15) 
hsc <- FindNeighbors(hsc, dims = 1:5)
hsc <- FindClusters(hsc, resolution = 0.3, cluster.name = "umap.inintegrated")
hsc <- RunUMAP(object = hsc, dims= 1:5, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = F, group.by = "Condition")

# Harmony
Idents(hsc) <- "umap.inintegrated"

hsc[["RNA"]] <- split(hsc[["RNA"]], f = hsc$Condition)

hsc <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = hsc, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony"
)

hsc <- FindNeighbors(hsc, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:5)
hsc <- FindClusters(hsc, resolution = 0.3, cluster.name = "Clusters_hsc")
hsc <- RunUMAP(hsc, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:5, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "Condition")

p <- Seurat::DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = TRUE, label.box = TRUE,pt.size = 0.35)

ggsave("plots/UMAP_LTHSC_Harmony_clusters.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)

save(hsc, file="rda/LTHSC_parse.rda")
```

## Transfer Seurat Object Metadata (Trailmaker) into "scte_clean"

**IMPORTANT: This step requires Seurat and SeuratObject to be upgraded to version > 5.0**

```{r scTE-transfer, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/parse_annotated.rda")
load("rda/scte_parse_clean.rda")

# 1) Preconditions & sanity checks
stopifnot(inherits(scte_clean, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(inherits(obj, "Seurat"))

if (!("cells" %in% colnames(scte_clean@meta.data))) {
  stop("scte_clean@meta.data$cells not found. Please create it with scTE-style IDs (e.g., '04_21_68').")
}
scte_key <- scte_clean@meta.data$cells
stopifnot(is.character(scte_key))
if (any(is.na(scte_key))) {
  message(sprintf("Note: %d NA values found in scte_clean@meta.data$cells; those rows won't match.", 
                  sum(is.na(scte_key))))
}
if (!all(grepl("^\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}$", scte_key[!is.na(scte_key)]))) {
  message("Note: some 'cells' values do not match the 'NN_NN_NN' pattern; join will proceed but matches may be fewer.")
}

# 2) Helpers to parse and build IDs
extract_triplet <- function(ids) {
  # Extract 'NN_NN_NN', ignoring optional '__s#' (case-insensitive)
  m <- stringr::str_match(ids, "^(\\d{2})_(\\d{2})_(\\d{2})(?i:(?:__s\\d+)?)$")
  out <- m[, 2:4, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(out) <- c("i1","i2","i3")
  as.data.frame(out, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

make_ids <- function(triplet_df, order = c(1,2,3)) {
  t <- as.matrix(triplet_df[, order, drop = FALSE])
  apply(t, 1, function(a) paste(a, collapse = "_"))
}

infer_best_permutation <- function(trail_ids, scte_ids_clean) {
  trail_trip <- extract_triplet(trail_ids)
  if (nrow(trail_trip) == 0) stop("No Trailmaker IDs parsed.")
  
  scte_set <- unique(scte_ids_clean[grepl("^\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}$", scte_ids_clean)])
  if (length(scte_set) == 0) stop("No valid scTE IDs in scte_clean@meta.data$cells.")
  
  perms <- list(
    c(1,2,3), c(1,3,2),
    c(2,1,3), c(2,3,1),
    c(3,1,2), c(3,2,1)
  )
  scores <- sapply(perms, function(p) {
    cand <- make_ids(trail_trip, order = p)
    sum(unique(cand[!is.na(cand)]) %in% scte_set)
  })
  
  for (i in seq_along(perms)) {
    message(sprintf("Permutation (%s) => overlap %d", paste(perms[[i]], collapse = ","), scores[i]))
  }
  best_idx <- which.max(scores)
  list(best_order = perms[[best_idx]], best_score = scores[best_idx])
}

# 3) Infer permutation & convert Trailmaker IDs → scTE-style
trail_ids <- colnames(obj)
perm_info <- infer_best_permutation(trail_ids, scte_key)
message(sprintf("Best order selected: (%s); overlap=%d",
                paste(perm_info$best_order, collapse = ","), perm_info$best_score))

if (perm_info$best_score == 0) {
  warning("No overlap detected across permutations. 'obj' and 'scte_clean' likely come from different samples/runs. No metadata will be transferred.")
} else {
  trail_trip <- extract_triplet(trail_ids)
  converted  <- make_ids(trail_trip, order = perm_info$best_order)
  invalid    <- apply(trail_trip, 1, function(row) any(is.na(row)))
  converted[invalid] <- NA
  
  overlap_n <- sum(unique(converted[!is.na(converted)]) %in% unique(scte_key))
  message(sprintf("Converted Trailmaker IDs overlapping scTE keys: %d", overlap_n))
  
# 4) Build mapping & prepare obj metadata
  map_id <- converted
  names(map_id) <- trail_ids
  
  obj_meta <- obj@meta.data
  obj_meta$trail_cell <- rownames(obj_meta)
  obj_meta$id_scTE    <- unname(map_id[obj_meta$trail_cell])
  
  # Keep only rows with a valid converted id AND present in scte_key
  keep <- !is.na(obj_meta$id_scTE) & obj_meta$id_scTE %in% scte_key
  obj_meta_matched <- obj_meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (nrow(obj_meta_matched) == 0) {
    warning("No matching rows after conversion. Nothing to transfer.")
  } else {
    message(sprintf("Matched %d Trailmaker cells to scTE cells.", nrow(obj_meta_matched)))
    
# 5) Collapse to ONE ROW PER id_scTE (avoid duplicating scte rows)
    obj_meta_by_id <- obj_meta_matched[!duplicated(obj_meta_matched$id_scTE), , drop = FALSE]
    
# 6) Choose columns to add (avoid overwriting existing names)
    scte_cols <- colnames(scte_clean@meta.data)
    add_cols  <- setdiff(colnames(obj_meta_by_id),
                         c("trail_cell", "id_scTE", scte_cols))
    
    if (length(add_cols) == 0) {
      message("No new columns to add (all already exist in scte_clean@meta.data).")
    } else {
      
# 7) Align order to scte rows and cbind new columns

      idx <- match(scte_key, obj_meta_by_id$id_scTE)  
      to_add <- obj_meta_by_id[idx, add_cols, drop = FALSE]  
      
      # Combine (row order preserved; rownames untouched)
      scte_clean@meta.data <- cbind(scte_clean@meta.data, to_add)
      
      message(sprintf("✅ Added %d new metadata columns to scte_clean: %s",
                      length(add_cols), paste(add_cols, collapse = ", ")))
    }
  }
}

# 8) Final sanity checks
stopifnot(identical(rownames(scte_clean@meta.data), colnames(scte_clean)))
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(rownames(scte_clean@meta.data)) == 0)
message("Done. scte_clean has Trailmaker metadata transferred where IDs matched.")

# 9) Removing NA

keep <- complete.cases(scte_clean@meta.data)
scte <- scte_clean[, keep]
dim(scte)

save(scte, file="rda/scte_parse_converted.rda")
```

### Genes 

```{r load-genes, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}

colnames(gencode)

                  "Gene.ID","Type","Gene.Name","Transc.Type")
```

### Transposable Elements (TEs)

### Integrating Genes & TEs

```{r integration, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/gencodeM21.rda")
load("rda/TEs.rda")

x <- TEs
rm(TEs)

gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(x, keep.extra.columns=TRUE)
names <- mcols(gr)$TE.Name

gen.gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(genes, keep.extra.columns=TRUE)

overlap <- suppressWarnings(findOverlaps(gr,gen.gr,ignore.strand=T, 
                                         type="within"))
a <- as.data.frame(overlap)
a <- a[with(a,order(queryHits,subjectHits)),]

genes$has.TE <- FALSE
genes[(a$subjectHits),"has.TE"] <- TRUE
table(genes$has.TE) 

genes$te.id <- NA
aux <- gr[(a$subjectHits),]
length(aux)

genes[(a$subjectHits), "te.id"] <- mcols(aux)[,1]
keep <- genes[a$subjectHits,]

keep$unique<- paste(keep$Gene.Name, keep$te.id, sep = "_")
keep <- keep[!duplicated(keep$unique),] 

save(keep, file="rda/TEs_annotated.rda")

rm(list=ls())
```

```{r promoters, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}

table(genes$TE.promoters)

length(aux)
```

```{r distribution-scte, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
  list(n = 4, pattern = "Rick", class = "non-LTR"),
  list(n = 6, pattern = "CENSAT", class = "Satellite"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "IMPB", class = "Satellite"),
  list(n = 2, pattern = "ID", class = "SINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "Kan", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "MARI", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 2, pattern = c("L1", "L4", "Lx"), class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "DNA", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 5, pattern = "MERVL", class = "Retrotransposon"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "RLTR", class = "LTR"),
  list(n = 1, pattern = "X", class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "RMER", class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 2, pattern = "MT", class = "LTR"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "MYSE", class = "ERV"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "Mam", class = "non-LTR"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "Plat", class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "Mur", class = "ERV"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "MMER", class = "ERV"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "HAL", class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "LFS", class = "SINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "SRV", class = "ERV")
)

see$TE.Class <- NA

for (r in rules) {
  match_idx <- substr(see$TE, 1, r$n) %in% r$pattern
  see$TE.Class[match_idx] <- r$class
}

scTE_class[scTE_class$TE %in% see$TE, "TE.Class"] <- 
  see$TE.Class[see$TE %in% scTE_class$TE]
table(scTE_class$TE.Class)

save(scTE_class, file="rda/scTE_class.rda")

# Plotting 
data <- scTE_class %>%
  group_by(TE.Class) %>%
  summarize(Counts = n())

data$TE.Class <- factor(data$TE.Class, levels = c("DNA","Retrotransposon","ERV","LTR","non-LTR","LINE","SINE","Satellite",
                                                  "Simple_repeat"))

data$Percentage <- data$Counts*100/1081

data$Percentage <- round(data$Percentage, 2)

data$Label <- paste0(data$Percentage, "%")

color <- brewer.pal(n=nrow(data),name = "Pastel1")

png("plots/Pie_TEs.png", width = 15, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
pie3D(
  x = data$Counts,
  labels = data$Label,
  explode = 0.05,
  col = color,
  labelcex = 0.75,
  main = "Percentage of each TE Class",
  theta = 1.2
)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("DNA","Retrotransposon","ERV","LTR","non-LT","LINE","SINE",
             "Satellite","Simple_repeat"),
  fill = color,
  cex = 0.9
)
dev.off()
```

# **PART 9 - Analyzing Exclusively LT-HSCs**

```{r exclus-LTHSC, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
hsc <- subset(seurat_te, subset = Score %in% c("LT-HSC"))
dim(hsc)  # 1081 8151

hsc <- subset(hsc, features = scTE_class$TE)
dim(hsc)

hsc <- JoinLayers(hsc)
save(hsc, file = "rda/seurat_te_LTHSC_tmp.rda")

# Heatmap
meta <- hsc@meta.data
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition, levels = c("Control", "Dnmt3aR878H"))

matrix <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$scale.data)
raw <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$counts)

matrix <- matrix[, rownames(meta)]
raw <- raw[, rownames(meta)]

table(meta$Condition)

condition <- factor(c(rep("Control", 4947),
                      rep("Dnmt3aR878H", 3204)))

all <- data.frame(TE = rownames(raw))

for (te in rownames(raw)) {
  
  a <- mean(raw[te, condition == "Control"])
  b <- mean(raw[te, condition == "Dnmt3aR878H"])
  
  all[all$TE == te, "Control"] <- a
  all[all$TE == te, "Dnmt3aR878H"] <- b
}

all2 <- pivot_longer(all,
                     cols = -TE,
                     names_to = c("Condition"),
                     values_to = "Counts")

a <- all2[all2$Counts >= 0.5, ]
b <- unique(a$TE)

raw_mat <- raw[b, ]
dim(raw_mat)

zscore <- function(x) {
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}

data <- as.data.frame(raw_mat)
zscore_data <- t(apply(data, 1, zscore))

dist_matrix <- dist(zscore_data)

# Cluster columns
a <- t(zscore_data)
hc <- hclust(dist(a), method = "ward.D2")
num_clusters <- 10
cl <- cutree(hc, k = num_clusters)

# Dendrogram
dend <- as.dendrogram(hc)

# labels(dend) are already in left-to-right dendrogram order
samples_in_order <- labels(dend)
cl_ordered <- cl[samples_in_order]

# Map raw cutree cluster ids to Group_1 ... Group_10 from left to right
cluster_levels_left_to_right <- unique(as.character(cl_ordered))

group_map <- setNames(
  paste0("Group_", seq_along(cluster_levels_left_to_right)),
  cluster_levels_left_to_right
)

group_left_to_right <- group_map[as.character(cl)]
names(group_left_to_right) <- names(cl)

# Build metadata table with dendrogram-based groups
g10 <- data.frame(
  Sample = names(group_left_to_right),
  Group = unname(group_left_to_right),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

merge <- merge(g10, meta, by.x = "Sample", by.y = "row.names")
rownames(merge) <- merge$Sample

# IMPORTANT: annotation order must match heatmap columns
merge <- merge[match(colnames(zscore_data), rownames(merge)), ]

# Group colors
group_colors <- c(
  "Group_1"  = "#1B9E77",
  "Group_2"  = "#D95F02",
  "Group_3"  = "#7570B3",
  "Group_4"  = "#E7298A",
  "Group_5"  = "#666666",
  "Group_6"  = "#A6761D",
  "Group_7"  = "#E6AB02",
  "Group_8"  = "cyan2",
  "Group_9"  = "darkred",
  "Group_10" = "#66A61E"
)

merge$Group <- factor(merge$Group, levels = names(group_colors))

# Reorder TE classes for row annotation
rownames(scTE_class) <- scTE_class$TE

scTE_class <- scTE_class[rownames(zscore_data), ]

order <- c("DNA", "Retrotransposon", "ERV", "LTR", "non-LTR", "LINE", "SINE",
           "Satellite")

scTE_class$TE.Class <- factor(scTE_class$TE.Class, levels = order)
scTE_class <- scTE_class[order(scTE_class$TE.Class), ]

zscore_data <- zscore_data[rownames(scTE_class), ]

class <- scTE_class$TE.Class
class <- unique(class)
class <- factor(class, levels = c("DNA", "Retrotransposon", "ERV", "LTR", "non-LTR",
                                  "LINE", "SINE", "Satellite"))

count_class <- length(class)

getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set1"))
class_colors <- getPalette(count_class)
list_cluster_colors <- setNames(class_colors, class)

h_class <- rowAnnotation(
  Class = scTE_class$TE.Class,
  col = list(Class = list_cluster_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

right_annot <- rowAnnotation(
  labels = anno_text(
    rownames(zscore_data),
    which = "row",
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 1, lineheight = 8)
  )
)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = merge$Group,
  Condition = merge$Condition,
  col = list(
    Group = group_colors,
    Condition = c(
      "Control" = "gray82",
      "Dnmt3aR878H" = "gray75"
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

# Color branches using the same left-to-right group color order
dend <- color_branches(dend, k = num_clusters, col = unname(group_colors))

htm <- Heatmap(
  zscore_data,
  name = "z-score per row",
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  column_title = NULL,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  column_dend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
  top_annotation = ha,
  cluster_columns = dend,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  right_annotation = right_annot,
  left_annotation = h_class,
  border = TRUE
)

png("plots/Heatmap_TEs_LTHSCs.png",
    width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.newpage()
draw(htm, newpage = FALSE)
dev.off()

meta <- merge(meta, merge[,c("Sample","Group")], by.x=0, by.y="Sample")

# Rearranging groups according to TE expression
meta$Group_ed <- meta$Group
meta[meta$Group %in% c("Group_7","Group_8","Group_9","Group_10"), "Group_ed"] <- "Group_7"
rownames(meta) <- meta$Row.names
meta_vec <- meta[colnames(hsc), "Group_ed"]
hsc <- AddMetaData(hsc, meta_vec, col.name = "Group")

save(hsc, file="rda/seurat_te_LTHSC_tmp.rda")

rm(list=ls())
```

## TE Counts Level (Threshold)

Here, we consider only DNA Transposon, LTR, Retrotransposon, SINE and LINE since these categories represent the
majority of TEs.

```{r TE-thr, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/scTE_class.rda")
load("rda/seurat_te_LTHSC_tmp.rda")

colors <- c("Control" = "gray82",
            "Dnmt3aR878H" = "gray75")

sigFunc <- function(x) {
  if (x < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  } else if (x <= 0.01) {
    return("**")
  } else if (x <= 0.05) {
    return("*")
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

# Retrotransposon
retro <- scTE_class$TE[scTE_class$TE.Class == "Retrotransposon"]
seurat <- subset(hsc, features = retro)
meta <- seurat@meta.data
meta <- meta[order(meta$Condition),]
matrix <- as.matrix(seurat@assays$RNA5$scale.data)
raw <- as.matrix(seurat@assays$RNA5$counts)
matrix <- matrix[,rownames(meta)]
raw <- raw[,rownames(meta)]
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition, levels = c("Control","Dnmt3aR878H"))
condition <- factor(c(rep("Control",4947),
                      rep("Dnmt3aR878H", 3204)))

all <- data.frame(TE=rownames(raw))

for (te in rownames(raw)) {
  a <- mean(raw[te,condition=="Control"])
  b <- mean(raw[te,condition=="Dnmt3aR878H"])
  all[all$TE == te, "Control"] <- a
  all[all$TE == te, "Dnmt3aR878H"] <- b
}

all2 <- pivot_longer(all, cols=-TE, names_to = c("Condition"),
                     values_to = "Counts")
a <- all2[all2$Counts >= 1,]
b <- unique(a$TE) 
raw_mat <- raw[b,]

meta$Condition <- as.character(meta$Condition)
box <- as.data.frame(t(raw_mat))
box$sum <- rowSums(box)
box$Cond[rownames(box) %in% rownames(meta)] <- 
  meta$Condition[rownames(meta) %in% rownames(box)]
box$cells <- rownames(box)
box <- box[,c(15:17)]

df <- box %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Cond, cells),  
    values_to = "counts")  

retro <- ggplot(data = df, mapping = aes(x = Cond, y = counts)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Cond), position = position_dodge(width = 1.5),
               outlier.shape = 16, 
               outlier.size = 0.65, outlier.colour = "red3") +  
  geom_jitter(data = df %>% filter(counts %in% boxplot.stats(counts)$out),  
              aes(x = Cond, y = counts), 
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), 
              size = 1.5, 
              colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 420, color = "gray85", linetype = "dashed", lwd=1) +
  stat_boxplot(aes(Cond, counts), geom = 'errorbar', linetype = 1,
               width = 0.3) + 
  stat_summary(aes(group = Cond), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1.5, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + 
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Total Counts") +
  geom_signif(test = "t.test", size = 0.25,
              comparisons = list(c("Control", "Dnmt3aR878H")),
              map_signif_level = sigFunc,
              y_position = max(df$counts)) +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("Control", 
                             "Dnmt3aR878H")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color="black"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 1, face = "bold", color="black", angle = 45),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white")
  )

ggsave("plots/Retrotransposon_Boxplot.png", retro, height=5.4, width=7.2, dpi=300)

retro.box <- df
```

# **PART 10 - Final Plots LT-HSC**

## Heatmap TEs

```{r final-heat, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/LTHSC_parse.rda")
all <- hsc
rm(hsc)
meta <- all@meta.data

load("rda/Boxplots_LTHSC_TE_cutoff.rda")
rm(dna.box,sine.box,line.box,ltr.box,retro.box, box)
plot <- plot[plot$cells %in% meta$cells,] #3197

load("rda/scTE_class.rda")
load("rda/seurat_te_LTHSC_tmp.rda")

metate <- hsc@meta.data
meta <- meta[meta$cells %in% metate$cells,]
metate <- metate[metate$cells %in% meta$cells,]

hsc <- subset(hsc, subset=cells %in% metate$cells)

meta <- merge(meta, metate[,c("cells","Group")], by.x="cells", by.y="cells")
meta <- merge(meta, plot[,c("cells","total","Level_Thr")], by.x="cells", by.y="cells")
rownames(meta) <- meta[,1]

# Editing the groups so they appear in ascending order
meta$Group_ed <- ""
meta[meta$Group == "Group_1","Group_ed"] <- "Group_3"
meta[(meta$Group == "Group_2" & meta$Condition == "Control"),"Group_ed"] <- "Group_4"
meta[(meta$Group == "Group_2" & meta$Condition == "Dnmt3aR878H"),"Group_ed"] <- "Group_5"
meta[(meta$Group == "Group_5" & meta$Condition == "Control"),"Group_ed"] <- "Group_5"
meta[meta$Group == "Group_3","Group_ed"] <- "Group_1"
meta[meta$Group == "Group_4","Group_ed"] <- "Group_2"
meta[(meta$Group == "Group_5" & meta$Condition == "Dnmt3aR878H"),"Group_ed"] <- "Group_6"
meta[(meta$Group == "Group_6" & meta$Condition == "Control"),"Group_ed"] <- "Group_6"
meta[meta$Group == "Group_7","Group_ed"] <- "Group_7"
meta[(meta$Group == "Group_6" & meta$Condition == "Dnmt3aR878H"),"Group_ed"] <- "Group_7"

# Editing the groups according to heatmap pre-plotted
meta$Group_final <- ""
meta[meta$Group_ed == "Group_1","Group_final"] <- "Group_1"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_2" & meta$Condition == "Dnmt3aR878H"),"Group_final"] <- "Group_2"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_2" & meta$Condition == "Control"),"Group_final"] <- "Group_3"
meta[meta$Group_ed == "Group_3","Group_final"] <- "Group_4"
meta[meta$Group_ed == "Group_4","Group_final"] <- "Group_5"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_5" & meta$Condition == "Dnmt3aR878H"),"Group_final"] <- "Group_5"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_5" & meta$Condition == "Control"),"Group_final"] <- "Group_6"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_6" & meta$Condition == "Dnmt3aR878H"),"Group_final"] <- "Group_6"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_6" & meta$Condition == "Control"),"Group_final"] <- "Group_7"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_7" & meta$Condition == "Dnmt3aR878H"),"Group_final"] <- "Group_7"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_7" & meta$Condition == "Control"),"Group_final"] <- "Group_8"
meta[(meta$Group_final == "Group_3" & meta$total <= 2200),"Group_final"] <- "Group_1"

meta$Group <- NULL
meta$Group_ed <- NULL
colnames(meta)[26] <- "Group"

meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition, levels=c("Control","Dnmt3aR878H"))
meta$Level_Thr <- factor(meta$Level_Thr, levels=c("Low","High"))
meta$Group <- factor(meta$Group, levels=paste0("Group_", 1:8))
meta <- meta[order(meta$Group, meta$Condition,meta$Level_Thr),]

matrix <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$scale.data)
raw <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$counts)
matrix <- matrix[,rownames(meta)]
raw <- raw[,rownames(meta)]

meta %>%
  mutate(Row = row_number(),
         ConditionBlock = data.table::rleid(Condition)) %>%
  group_by(ConditionBlock, Condition) %>%
  summarise(Start = min(Row), End = max(Row), .groups = "drop")

blocks <- tibble::tibble(
  ConditionBlock = 1:10,
  Condition = c("Control", "Dnmt3aR878H", "Control", "Dnmt3aR878H",
                "Control", "Dnmt3aR878H", "Control", "Dnmt3aR878H","Control", "Dnmt3aR878H"),
  Start = c(1, 781, 2520, 4363, 4941, 6106,6600, 7096, 7297,7725),
  End   = c(780, 2519, 4362, 4340, 6105, 6599,7095, 7296, 7724,7916)
)

# Generate the condition vector
valid_blocks <- blocks %>%
  filter(!is.na(Start), !is.na(End), End >= Start)

condition <- unlist(mapply(function(cond, start, end) {
  rep(cond, end - start + 1)
}, valid_blocks$Condition, valid_blocks$Start, valid_blocks$End))

# Convert to factor if needed
condition <- factor(condition)

all <- data.frame(TE=rownames(raw))

for (te in rownames(raw)) {
  control_values <- raw[te, condition == "Control"]
  Dnmt3aR878H_values <- raw[te, condition == "Dnmt3aR878H"]
  
  a <- mean(control_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  b <- mean(Dnmt3aR878H_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  all[all$TE == te, "Control"] <- a
  all[all$TE == te, "Dnmt3aR878H"] <- b
}

all2 <- pivot_longer(all, cols=-TE, names_to = c("Condition"), 
                     values_to = "Counts")

a <- all2[all2$Counts >= 1,]
b <- unique(a$TE)

raw_mat <- raw[b,]
raw_mat <- raw_mat[,rownames(meta)]

zscore <- function(x) {
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}

data <- as.data.frame(raw_mat)

zscore_data <- t(apply(data, 1, zscore))

rownames(scTE_class) <- scTE_class$TE

scTE_class <- scTE_class[rownames(zscore_data),]
order <- c("DNA","Retrotransposon","ERV","LTR","non-LTR","LINE","SINE",
           "Satellite")
scTE_class$TE.Class <- factor(scTE_class$TE.Class, levels= order)
scTE_class <- scTE_class[order(scTE_class$TE.Class),]

zscore_data <- zscore_data[rownames(scTE_class),]
zscore_data <- zscore_data[,rownames(meta)]

class <- scTE_class$TE.Class
class <- unique(class)
class <- factor(class, levels= c("DNA","Retrotransposon","ERV","LTR","non-LTR",
                                 "LINE","SINE","Satellite"))

h_class <- rowAnnotation(Class = scTE_class$TE.Class,
                         col = list(
                           Class = c(
                             "DNA" = "#7FC97F",
                             "Retrotransposon" = "#C8B1C9",
                             "ERV" = "#FFFF99",
                             "LTR" = "#FDC086",
                             "non-LTR" = "#FFE4E1",
                             "LINE" = "#B2258F",
                             "SINE" = "#AB82FF",
                             "Satellite" = "#F781BF")
                         ),
                         show_annotation_name = FALSE)

names <- rowAnnotation(
  labels = anno_text(rownames(zscore_data), 
                     which = "row",
                     gp = gpar(fontsize = 3, lineheight = 8))) 

ha1 <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Condition = meta$Condition,
  Group = meta$Group,
  col = list(
    Condition = c("Control" = "gray82",
                  "Dnmt3aR878H" = "gray75"),
    Group = c(
      "Group_1" = "#386CB0",
      "Group_2" = "#8DB6CD",
      "Group_3" = "#FFF8DC",
      "Group_4" = "#FFDEAD",
      "Group_5" = "#FFC125",
      "Group_6" = "#D95F02",
      "Group_7" = "red2",
      "Group_8" = "darkred")),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

# Anno Point
ha2 = HeatmapAnnotation(
  dist1 = anno_points(
    colSums(raw_mat), 
    col = ifelse(meta$Level[match(colnames(raw),
                                  rownames(meta))] == "Low", "blue2", "red2"),
    pch = 16, size = unit(0.55, "mm"), 
    bar_width = 1, 
    border = TRUE,
    height = unit(3.6, "cm"),
  ), 
  show_annotation_name = FALSE)

hax <- c(ha2,ha1)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = c(-4,-2,0,2,4), 
  colors = c("gray35","#1874CD","white","#FFC125","red")
)

p <- Heatmap(zscore_data, 
              name = "zscore",
              col = col_fun,
              show_column_names = FALSE,
              column_title = NULL,
              show_row_names = FALSE, 
              cluster_rows = FALSE,
              show_row_dend = FALSE,
              top_annotation = hax,
              cluster_columns = FALSE,  
              show_column_dend = FALSE,
              left_annotation = h_class,
              border = TRUE
)

png("plots/Heatmap_TEs_LTHSCs_Final.png",width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.newpage()
draw(p, newpage = FALSE)
dev.off()

meta <- meta[colnames(hsc),]

hsc$Group <- NULL
hsc <- AddMetaData(hsc, meta$Group, col = "Group")

save(hsc, file="rda/seurat_te_LTHSC.rda")
save(zscore_data, file="rda/zscore_data_LTHSC.rda")
```

```{r UMAP-TE-Level, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
meta <- obj@meta.data[,c(14,18,19,20,21)]

meta$Score <- as.character(meta$Score)

merged <- merged %>% mutate(
  Score = ifelse(is.na(Score), "Other", Score),
  Level = ifelse(is.na(Level), "Other", Level),

)

obj@meta.data[(obj@meta.data$Group == "Group_2" & obj@meta.data$Level != "Other"), "Level"] <- "Low"
obj@meta.data[(obj@meta.data$Group == "Group_3" & obj@meta.data$Level != "Other"), "Level"] <- "Low"
obj@meta.data[(obj@meta.data$Group == "Group_4" & obj@meta.data$Level != "Other"), "Level"] <- "Low"
```

# **PART 11 - Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs)**

Given that the "UMAP TE Level" shows overlap between LT-HSCs with Low and High TE expression, let us focus on the
heterogeneity of the LT-HSCs presented in "UMAP_LTHSC_Harmony_clusters.png" to characterize this cell population.

## Preparing Pseudobulk

**Question:** How does gene expression explain the heterogeneity of LT-HSCs?

### Markers 

```{r degs, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/LTHSC_parse_complete.rda")

# All Markers per LT-HSC Cluster
Idents(all)
meta <- all@meta.data
all <- JoinLayers(all)

markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = all,
  group.by = Idents(all), 
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

markers <- markers[markers$p_val_adj <= 0.05,] # 2342

# Conserved Markers
Idents(all) <- "Level"
cons.markers <- FindConservedMarkers(all, ident.1 = "High", ident.2 = "Low", 
                                     grouping.var = "Condition", verbose = FALSE) # 5504

conserved <- cons.markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    max_pval < 0.05,
    Dnmt3aR878H_avg_log2FC > 0,
    Control_avg_log2FC > 0,
    Dnmt3aR878H_pct.1 > 0.1,
    Control_pct.1 > 0.1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(max_pval) # 95

markers <- markers[!rownames(markers) %in% rownames(conserved),] # 2318
markers$p_val <- NULL
colnames(markers) <- c("log2FC","High","Low","pval.adj","Cluster","Gene")
markers$dif <- markers$High - markers$Low
markers <- markers[markers$dif != 0,] # 2308
markers$dif <- NULL

markers$status <- "ns"
markers[markers$log2FC > 0, "status"] <- "Upregulated in High TE expression"
markers[markers$log2FC < 0, "status"] <- "Downregulated in High TE expression"

counts <- markers %>%
  group_by(Cluster, status) %>%
  summarise(Gene = n())

counts <- counts %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = c("0","1","2","3")),
    status  = factor(status, levels = c(
      "Upregulated in High TE expression",
      "Downregulated in High TE expression"
    ))
  )

counts2 <- counts %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = as.character(Cluster),
    status  = as.character(status)
  )

cluster_levels <- sort(unique(counts2$Cluster))
counts2$Cluster <- factor(counts2$Cluster, levels = cluster_levels)

status_levels <- c("Upregulated in High TE expression",
                   "Downregulated in High TE expression")
counts2$status <- factor(counts2$status, levels = status_levels)

# Inner ring: cluster totals & angular spans
inner <- counts2 %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(cluster_total = sum(Gene), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = lag(cumsum(cluster_total), default = 0),
    ymax = cumsum(cluster_total),
    ymid = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  )

# Outer ring: split Up/Down within each cluster span
outer <- counts2 %>%
  left_join(inner %>% dplyr::select(Cluster, cluster_total, cluster_ymin = ymin), by = "Cluster") %>%
  arrange(Cluster, status) %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_in_cluster = Gene / cluster_total,
    ymin = cluster_ymin + lag(cumsum(Gene), default = 0),
    ymax = cluster_ymin + cumsum(Gene),
    ymid = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cluster_cols <- c(
  "0" = "#F8766D",
  "1" = "#7CAE00",
  "2" = "#00BFC4",
  "3" = "#C77CFF"
)

status_cols <- c(
  "Upregulated in High TE expression" = "brown1",
  "Downregulated in High TE expression"   = "royalblue1"
)

cluster_cols <- cluster_cols[levels(counts2$Cluster)] 

p <- ggplot() +
  # OUTER ring (status within cluster)
  geom_rect(
    data = outer,
    aes(xmin = 1.5, xmax = 2.5, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = status),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = outer,
    aes(x = 2.62, y = ymid, label = percent(pct_in_cluster, accuracy = 0.1)),
    size = 3.65
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_cols, name = "status", drop = FALSE) +
  
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  
  # INNER ring (cluster)
  geom_rect(
    data = inner,
    aes(xmin = 0.6, xmax = 1.5, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = Cluster),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = inner,
    aes(x = 1.05, y = ymid, label = Cluster),
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols, name = "Cluster", drop = FALSE) +
  
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.4, 2.85) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave("plots/Pie_chart_DEGs.png", p, height=5.4, width=7.2, dpi=300)

save(markers, file="rda/markers_LTHSC.rda")
write.csv(markers, "csv/markers_LTHSC.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Lolliplot
markers$Cluster <- paste0("Cluster_", markers$Cluster)

df <- markers %>%
  group_by(Cluster, status) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

colnames(df)[3] <- "Total"

df$Cluster <- factor(df$Cluster, levels = paste0("Cluster_", 0:3))
df$status <- factor(df$status, levels = c("Upregulated in High TE expression","Downregulated in High TE expression"))

df <- df[order(df$Cluster, df$status),]

df$Group <- paste(df$Cluster, "_", df$status)

df$Group <- factor(df$Group, levels = c("Cluster_0 _ Upregulated in High TE expression",

                                        "Cluster_2 _ Upregulated in High TE expression",
                                        "Cluster_2 _ Downregulated in High TE expression",
                                        "Cluster_3 _ Upregulated in High TE expression",
                                        "Cluster_3 _ Downregulated in High TE expression"))

  theme_bw() +

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color="black"),

    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
```

```{r starburst, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
colnames(high.sig)[2:4] <- c("logFC", "Dnmt3aR878H","Control") 
write.csv(high.sig, "csv/markers_LTHSC_High_TE_Expression.csv", row.names = TRUE)

save(markers.high, markers.low,file="rda/starburst_markers.rda")

# Plot
low.sig <- low.sig %>%
  rownames_to_column("genes") %>%
  transmute(
    genes,
    log2FC_Low = as.numeric(logFC),
    p_low      = p_val_adj
  ) 

high.sig <- high.sig %>%
  rownames_to_column("genes") %>%
  transmute(
    genes,
    log2FC_High = as.numeric(logFC),
    p_high      = p_val_adj
  ) 

star <- inner_join(low.sig, high.sig, by = "genes")  

low.sig <- low.sig[!low.sig$genes %in% star$genes,] # 4925
high.sig <- high.sig[!high.sig$genes %in% star$genes,] # 33

sigs <- bind_rows(low.sig, high.sig) # 4958
star <- star[(star$p_high <= 0.05 & star$p_low <= 0.05),] # 208

merge <- bind_rows(star, sigs) # 5166
merge[is.na(merge$log2FC_High),"log2FC_High"] <- 0
merge[is.na(merge$log2FC_Low),"log2FC_Low"] <- 0
merge[is.na(merge$p_high),"p_high"] <- 1
merge[is.na(merge$p_low),"p_low"] <- 1

merge <- merge %>%
  mutate(
    quadrant = case_when(
      log2FC_High > 0 & log2FC_Low > 0 ~ "Up/Up",
      log2FC_High > 0 & log2FC_Low <  0 ~ "Up/Down",
      log2FC_High <  0 & log2FC_Low > 0 ~ "Down/Up",
      log2FC_High < 0 & log2FC_Low < 0  ~ "Down/Down",
      log2FC_High > 0 & log2FC_Low == 0  ~ "Up/ns",
      log2FC_High < 0 & log2FC_Low == 0  ~ "Down/ns",
      log2FC_High == 0 & log2FC_Low > 0  ~ "ns/Up",
      log2FC_High == 0 & log2FC_Low < 0  ~ "ns/Down"
    ),
    sig_both = (p_high <= 0.05 & p_low <= 0.05),      
    dist     = sqrt(log2FC_High^2 + log2FC_Low^2)     
  )

merge$quadrant <- factor(merge$quadrant, levels = c("Up/Up","Up/Down","Down/Up","Down/Down",
                                                    "Up/ns","Down/ns","ns/Up","ns/Down"))

quad_pal <- c(
  "Up/Up"     = "red2",
  "Up/Down"  = "seagreen",   
  "Down/Up"   = "#FFB90F",
  "Down/Down"   = "steelblue3",
  "Up/ns" = "purple",
  "Down/ns" ="cyan3",
  "ns/Up" = "#FF7F00",
  "ns/Down" =  "#4169E1"
)

label <- merge %>%
  mutate(dist = sqrt(log2FC_High^2 + log2FC_Low^2)) %>%
  group_by(quadrant) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = dist, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

p <- ggplot(merge, aes(x = log2FC_High, y = log2FC_Low)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey80") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey80") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = log2FC_High, yend = log2FC_Low),
               size = 0.25, color = "grey80") + 
  geom_point(aes(color = quadrant), shape = 16, size = 1.5) + 
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.35, `TRUE` = 1.0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red2","seagreen", "#FFB90F", "steelblue3", "purple","cyan3","#FF7F00","#4169E1"),
     labels=c("Upregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (High and Low TE expression) (N=151)",
                              
         "Upregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (High TE expression) and Downregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (Low TE expression) (N=1)",
                    
         "Upregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (Low TE expression) and Downregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (High TE expression) (N=1)",
                    
         "Downregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (High and Low TE expression) (N=55)",
                    
         "Upregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (High TE expression) and ns in Dnmt3aR878H (Low TE expression) (N=27)",
                    
         "Downregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (High TE expression) and ns in Dnmt3aR878H (Low TE expression) (N=6)",
                    
         "ns in Dnmt3aR878H (High TE expression) and Upregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (Low TE expression) (N=1,950)",
                    
         "ns in Dnmt3aR878H (High TE expression) and Downregulated in Dnmt3aR878H (Low TE expression) (N=2,975)")
     ) +
  coord_equal() + 
  labs(colour = "Status",title = "DEGs (N=5,166)",  
       x = "log2FC (High_TE: Mutant vs Control)", 
       y = "log2FC (Low_TE:  Mutant vs Control)") +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = label,
    aes(x = log2FC_High, y = log2FC_Low,
        label = genes, color = quadrant),
    size =3,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    force = 2,
    nudge_y = 0.65,
    label.size = 0.2,        
    show.legend = FALSE
  )

ggsave("plots/Starburst_DEGs_LTHSC.png", p, height=12, width=16, dpi=300)

save(merge,file="rda/starburst_plot.rda")
write.csv(merge, "csv/starburst_DEGs_LTHSC.csv", row.names = FALSE)

rm(list=ls())
```

# **PART 12 - Pathway Enrichment Analysis**

You will observe that, out of a total of 143 unique DEGs, only 30 exhibited pathway enrichment.

```{r run-enrichment, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/starburst_plot.rda")

up_low <- merge[merge$quadrant == "Down/Up",] # 1
up_high <- merge[merge$quadrant == "Up/Down",] # 1
rm(up_low, up_high)

up_high_only <- merge[merge$quadrant == "Up/ns",]
up_low_only <- merge[merge$quadrant == "ns/Up",]

# UP High Only

genes <- up_high_only$genes
go <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
               OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db",
               keyType = "SYMBOL",
               ont = "BP")

up_high_only_a <- as.data.frame(go)

up_high_only_a$ID <- NULL
up_high_only_a$ID <- make.names(up_high_only_a$Description)
rownames(up_high_only_a) <- up_high_only_a$ID

geneList <- strsplit(up_high_only_a$geneID, "/")
names(geneList) <- rownames(up_high_only_a)

enrichres <- new("enrichResult",
                 readable = FALSE,
                 result = up_high_only_a,
                 pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                 qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                 organism = "mouse",
                 ontology = "UNKNOWN",
                 gene = unique(up_high_only_a$geneID),
                 keytype = "UNKNOWN",
                 universe = unique(up_high_only_a$geneID),
                 gene2Symbol = character(0),
                 geneSets = geneList)

a <- pairwise_termsim(enrichres)
sig_up_high_only <- as.data.frame(a)

emapplot_cluster(a) 

# UP Low Only
genes <- up_low_only$genes
go <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
               OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db",
               keyType = "SYMBOL",
               ont = "BP")

up_low_only_a <- as.data.frame(go)

up_low_only_a$ID <- NULL
up_low_only_a$ID <- make.names(up_low_only_a$Description)
rownames(up_low_only_a) <- up_low_only_a$ID

geneList <- strsplit(up_low_only_a$geneID, "/")
names(geneList) <- rownames(up_low_only_a)

enrichres <- new("enrichResult",
                 readable = FALSE,
                 result = up_low_only_a,
                 pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                 qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                 organism = "mouse",
                 ontology = "UNKNOWN",
                 gene = unique(up_low_only_a$geneID),
                 keytype = "UNKNOWN",
                 universe = unique(up_low_only_a$geneID),
                 gene2Symbol = character(0),
                 geneSets = geneList)

a <- pairwise_termsim(enrichres)
sig_up_low_only <- as.data.frame(a)

emapplot_cluster(a)
treeplot(a)

save(up_high_only_a, sig_up_high_only, up_low_only_a, sig_up_low_only, file="rda/bps.rda")
rm(list=ls())

# Organizing
load("rda/starburst_plot.rda")
merge <- subset(merge, !(quadrant %in% c("Up/Up","Down/Down")))
merge <- merge[, c(1:6)]

load("rda/bps.rda")

dfs <- list(sig_up_high_only = sig_up_high_only, sig_up_low_only = sig_up_low_only)

keep <- c(1, 5, 7)

for (nm in names(dfs)) {
  d <- dfs[[nm]]
  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      Description = if ("Description" %in% names(.)) {
        x <- as.character(Description)
        x <- tolower(x)
        sub("^([a-zA-Z])", "\\U\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
      } else {
        Description
      }
    )
  k <- keep[keep <= ncol(d)]
  d <- d[, k, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(d) <- NULL
  
  assign(nm, d, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

dfs <- list(
  sig_up_high_only = sig_up_high_only,
  sig_up_low_only  = sig_up_low_only
)

# Patterns
bp_rules <- c(
  "(?i)dna" = "DNA",
  "(?i)rna" = "RNA",
  "g1/s"    = "G1/S",
  "g2/m"    = "G2/M",
  "(?i)cd4" = "CD4",
  "(?i)gtpase" = "GTPase",
  "RRNA"    = "rRNA",
  "NcRNA"   = "ncRNA",
  "TRNA"    = "tRNA",
  "MiRNA"   = "miRNA",
  "Gmp"     = "GMP",
  "Gtp"     = "GTP",
  "g1 s"    = "G1/S"
)

fix_bp <- function(d, col = "Description") {
  if (!col %in% names(d)) return(d)
  x <- d[[col]]
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, x)
  d[[col]] <- str_replace_all(x, bp_rules)
  d
}

for (nm in names(dfs)) {
  d <- dfs[[nm]]

    if ("Description" %in% names(d)) {
    d <- fix_bp(d, "Description")
  }
  
  required <- c("Description", "p.adjust", "geneID")
  if (all(required %in% names(d))) {
    d <- d %>%
      dplyr::select(Description, p.adjust, geneID) %>%
      tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/", convert = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::rename(Gene = geneID, p.adj = p.adjust) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Gene = ifelse(is.na(Gene), NA_character_, stringr::str_trim(Gene))) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene) & Gene != "")
  } 
  assign(nm, d, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

# Merging
sig_up_low_only <- merge(sig_up_low_only, merge[,c("genes","log2FC_High","p_high","log2FC_Low","p_low","quadrant" )], by.x="Gene", by.y = "genes")
                         
sig_up_high_only <- merge(sig_up_high_only, merge[,c("genes","log2FC_High","p_high","log2FC_Low","p_low","quadrant" )], by.x="Gene", by.y = "genes")

# Anti Join
sig_up_low_only <- anti_join(sig_up_low_only, sig_up_high_only, by = c("Description")) 
sig_up_high_only <- anti_join(sig_up_high_only, sig_up_low_only, by = c("Description")) 

save(sig_up_high_only, sig_up_low_only,file="rda/sig_fixed.rda")

# Genes to Flag

)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("mitochond|respir|ATP|energy", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Mitochondria - Metabolism & Energy",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("DNA|repair|replication|chromatin", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "DNA & Genome Stability",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("RNA|translation|ribosome|transcription", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Gene Expression",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("immune|cytokine|leukocyte|virus", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Immune Response",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("apopt|cell death|necrot", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Cell Death",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("epigenetic|methylation", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Epigenetics",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("cytoskeleton|actin|migration|motility", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Cell Structure & Motility",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("protein folding|proteasome|ubiquitin|protein", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Protein Homeostasis",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("transport|localization|vesicle", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Transport & Trafficking",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("stress|oxidative|heat", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Stress Response",
    
    str_detect(Description, regex("metabolic|catabolic|biosynthetic", 
                                  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "General Metabolism",
    
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.adj)) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = p.adj, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

genes <- unique(df$Gene) 

mat <- mat[genes,]
meta$avg <- paste(meta$Condition, meta$Level, meta$Clusters_hsc,sep = "_")

avg_df <- aggregate(t(mat), by = list(group = meta$avg), FUN = mean)

mat_avg <- t(as.matrix(avg_df[ , -1]))
colnames(mat_avg) <- avg_df$group
dim(mat_avg)

mat_avg <- t(scale(t(mat_avg)))

group_info <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(colnames(mat_avg), "_"))

col_meta_avg <- data.frame(Condition = group_info[,1],
                           TE     = group_info[,2],
                           Cluster   = group_info[,4],
                           row.names = colnames(mat_avg))

col_meta_avg$Cluster <- paste0("Cluster_", col_meta_avg$Cluster)

col_meta_avg$Condition <- factor(col_meta_avg$Condition, levels = c("Control","Dnmt3aR878H"))
col_meta_avg$TE <- factor(col_meta_avg$TE, levels = c("Low","High"))
col_meta_avg$Cluster <- factor(col_meta_avg$Cluster, levels = paste0("Cluster_", 0:3))

  ),

)

getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))

}
```

```{r surface-markers, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/LTHSC_parse_complete.rda")

all <- JoinLayers(all)

all@meta.data$Clusters_hsc <- paste0("Cluster_", all@meta.data$Clusters_hsc)

groups_use <- c("Cluster_0","Cluster_1","Cluster_2","Cluster_3")
conditions_use <- c("Control", "Dnmt3aR878H")

group_col <- "Clusters_hsc"
condition_col <- "Condition"   

all[[group_col]][, 1] <- factor(all[[group_col]][, 1], levels = groups_use)
all[[condition_col]][, 1] <- factor(all[[condition_col]][, 1], levels = conditions_use)
all$Group_Condition <- paste(all$Clusters_hsc, all$Condition, sep = "_")
all$Group_Condition <- factor(
  all$Group_Condition,
  levels = as.vector(
    outer(groups_use, conditions_use, paste, sep = "_")
  )
)

Idents(all) <- "Group_Condition"
avg_expr <- AverageExpression(
  all,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data",
  features = surf
)$RNA

zmat <- t(scale(t(avg_expr)))
colnames(zmat) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(zmat))
zmat[is.na(zmat)] <- 0
zmat[zmat > 2] <- 2
zmat[zmat < -2] <- -2

col_order <- paste0(
  rep(groups_use, each = length(conditions_use)),
  "_",
  rep(conditions_use, times = length(groups_use))
)

col_order <- col_order[col_order %in% colnames(zmat)]
zmat <- zmat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]

annotation_df <- data.frame(
  Cluster = sub("_(Control|Dnmt3aR878H)$", "", col_order),
  Condition = sub("^Cluster_[0-9]+_", "", col_order)
)

rownames(annotation_df) <- col_order

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = annotation_df,
  col = list(
    Cluster = c(
      Cluster_0 = "#F8766D",
      Cluster_1 = "#7CAE00",
      Cluster_2 = "#00BFC4",
      Cluster_3 = "#C77CFF"
    ),
    Condition = c(
      Control = "grey82",
      Dnmt3aR878H = "grey75"
    ),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    show_annotation_name = TRUE,
    gap = unit(2, "mm")
  ))

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = c(-2,0,2), 
  colors = c("#1874CD","white","red")
)

sur <- Heatmap(
  zmat,
  name = "z-score",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(-2,0,2),
    labels = c("-2", "0","2"),
    color_bar = "continuous",
    legend_direction = "vertical"),
  column_split = annotation_df$Cluster,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

png("plots/Heatmap_Surface_Markers_LTHSC_DEGs.png",width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.newpage()
ComplexHeatmap::draw(sur, newpage = FALSE)
dev.off()

write.csv(zmat, "csv/Matrix_Surface_Markers_LTHSC_DEGs_Avg.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

# **PART 15 - scMINER**

scMINER is a package developed by jyyulab. The tutorial can be found here:
https://github.com/jyyulab/scMINER

## Creating SparseEset Objects

```{r scMINER, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/parse_complete.rda")

obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
assay_use <- DefaultAssay(obj)  
expr <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay_use, layer = "data")
expr <- as.matrix(expr)

rownames(expr) <- make.unique(rownames(expr), sep = "_")

pdata <- obj@meta.data
pdata <- pdata[colnames(expr), , drop = FALSE]

fdata <- data.frame(
  gene_symbol = rownames(expr),
  row.names   = rownames(expr),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

eset <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData  = expr,
  phenoData  = AnnotatedDataFrame(pdata),
  featureData= AnnotatedDataFrame(fdata))

stopifnot(identical(colnames(expr), rownames(pdata)))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(expr), rownames(fdata)))

meta <- obj@meta.data
cells <- rownames(meta)

common_cells <- intersect(cells, colnames(eset))
eset <- eset[, common_cells] 

# Filtering
expr <- Biobase::exprs(eset)
keep <- rowSums(expr > 0) >= 10
eset <- eset[keep, ]

# Normalizing
eset <- normalizeSparseEset(eset, scale_factor = 1000000, log_base = 2, log_pseudoCount = 1)

expr <- Biobase::exprs(eset)
gene_var <- apply(expr, 1, var)
top_genes <- names(sort(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE))[1:8000]
eset <- eset[top_genes, ]

save(eset, file="rda/eset.rda")
```

```{r mica-input, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
mica[1:5,1:5]
```

## Running MICA (python)

This part was performed on an HPC using python=3.9.2 following the steps described here: https://github.com/jyyulab/scMINER

```{r mica-run, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/eset.rda")
load("rda/LTHSC_parse_complete.rda")

out <- read.table("scMINER/micaOutput/clustering_UMAP_euclidean_20_2.0.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", 
                  quote = "", stringsAsFactors = F)

eset <- addMICAoutput(eset, mica_output_file = ("scMINER/micaOutput/clustering_UMAP_euclidean_20_2.0.txt"), 
                      visual_method = "umap")
head(phenoData(eset))

MICAplot(input_eset = eset, color_by = "clusterID", X = "UMAP_1", Y = "UMAP_2", point.size = 0.1, 
         fontsize.cluster_label = 6)

# Save
save(eset, file="rda/eset_combined.rda")
rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

## SJARACNe - Network Inference

This second part was performed on an HPC using python=3.9.2 following the steps described here: https://github.com/jyyulab/scMINER

Here, I did not include "MEP" as scMINER failed in identifying the network inference for this cell type.

I also removed HSC_High, HSC_Medium and HSC_Low from the analysis as these scores were used only to help identifying LT_HSC (our goal).

```{r sjaracne, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/eset_combined.rda")

phenoData(eset)$HSCscore <- gsub("-", "_", phenoData(eset)$HSCscore)

# 1) Generating Input
generateSJARACNeInput(input_eset = eset, group_name = "HSCscore", 
                      sjaracne_dir = "scMINER/SJARACNe/", species_type = "mm",
                      driver_type = "TF_SIG", downSample_N = 800)

# 2) Assessing the quality of the Network
subtypes <- c("CMP","GMP","LMPP","LT_HSC","MPP1","MPP2","MPP3","ST_HSC")

for (subtype in subtypes) {
  
  input_dir <- normalizePath(
  file.path("scMINER/SJARACNe", subtype, "TF"),
  winslash = "/"
)
  output_rds <- file.path("scMINER/SJARACNe", subtype, "TF", "network_stats.rds")
  
  # Run drawNetworkQC
  cat("Processing:", subtype, "\n")
  network <- scMINER::drawNetworkQC(sjaracne_dir = input_dir, generate_html = TRUE)
  
  # Save the network stats
  saveRDS(network, file = output_rds)
}

# 3) scMINER activity calculation with TF+SIG for all subtypes
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Biobase)  
})

subtypes <- c("CMP","GMP","LMPP","LT_HSC","MPP1","MPP2","MPP3","ST_HSC")

base_dir <- "scMINER/SJARACNe"

## Metadata extractor with SparseExpressionSet support
get_meta <- function(x) {
  cls <- class(x)
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% cls || "ExpressionSet" %in% cls) {
    return(Biobase::pData(x))
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class: ", paste(cls, collapse = ", "))
}

## Gene and cell names (avoid touching assay matrix)
get_gene_names <- function(x) {
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% class(x) || "ExpressionSet" %in% class(x)) {
    return(Biobase::featureNames(x))
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class for gene names.")
}
get_cell_names <- function(x) {
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% class(x) || "ExpressionSet" %in% class(x)) {
    return(Biobase::sampleNames(x))
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class for cell names.")
}

## Safe subsetting that preserves sparsity for SparseExpressionSet
subset_eset_cells <- function(obj, cell_idx) {
  if (is.logical(cell_idx)) {
    cell_idx <- which(cell_idx)
  }
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% class(obj) || "ExpressionSet" %in% class(obj)) {
    return(obj[, cell_idx])
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class for cell subsetting.")
}
subset_eset_genes <- function(obj, genes_keep) {
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% class(obj) || "ExpressionSet" %in% class(obj)) {
    current_genes <- get_gene_names(obj)
    keep <- intersect(current_genes, genes_keep)
    if (length(keep) == 0L) {
      message("Warning: no overlap between network genes and dataset genes; keeping all genes.")
      return(obj)
    }
    return(obj[keep, ])
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class for gene subsetting.")
}

## Find a consensus network file in a directory, robust to small naming diffs
find_network_file <- function(dir_path) {
  if (!dir.exists(dir_path)) return(NA_character_)
  candidates <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "^consensus_network_ncol.*\\.txt$",
                           full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    candidates <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "ncol.*\\.txt$",
                             full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  if (length(candidates) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  # Prefer the bare consensus file over any NetworkQC HTML-adjacent copy
  exact <- candidates[basename(candidates) == "consensus_network_ncol_.txt"]
  if (length(exact) >= 1) return(exact[1])
  candidates[1]
}

## Read genes from a 2+ column edge list (TF \t Target); returns unique union
read_network_genes <- function(path) {
  df <- tryCatch(utils::read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = ""),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df) || ncol(df) < 2) return(character())
  unique(c(df[[1]], df[[2]]))
}

phenoData(eset)$HSCscore <- gsub("-", "_", phenoData(eset)$HSCscore)

subtypes <- c("CMP", "GMP", "LMPP", "LT_HSC", "MPP1", "MPP2", "MPP3", "ST_HSC")

## Determine annotation column automatically ---
meta <- get_meta(eset)
ann_candidates <- c("Subtype","subtype","celltype","CellType","Cluster","cluster","HSCscore")
ann_col <- ann_candidates[ann_candidates %in% colnames(meta)][1]
if (is.na(ann_col)) {
  stop("Could not find an annotation column among: ",
       paste(ann_candidates, collapse = ", "),
       ". Available columns: ", paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", "))
}

activity_list <- list()

for (subtype in subtypes) {
  idx <- meta[[ann_col]] == subtype
  if (!any(idx, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    message(sprintf("No cells found for '%s' using column '%s' — skipping.", subtype, ann_col))
    activity_list[[subtype]] <- NULL
    next
  }
  
  tf_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, subtype, "TF")
  sig_dir <- file.path(base_dir, subtype, "SIG")
  
  tf_path  <- find_network_file(tf_dir)
  sig_path <- find_network_file(sig_dir)
  
  if (is.na(tf_path) || is.na(sig_path)) {
    message(sprintf("Missing TF or SIG network for '%s'. TF: %s | SIG: %s — skipping.",
                    subtype, ifelse(is.na(tf_path), "NOT FOUND", basename(tf_path)),
                    ifelse(is.na(sig_path), "NOT FOUND", basename(sig_path))))
    activity_list[[subtype]] <- NULL
    next
  }
  
  message(sprintf("Running %s | driver_type=TF_SIG | TF=%s | SIG=%s",
                  subtype, basename(tf_path), basename(sig_path)))
  
  # Reduce memory: subset cells, then genes to network union (preserves sparsity)
  sub_cells <- subset_eset_cells(eset, idx)
  net_genes <- unique(c(read_network_genes(tf_path), read_network_genes(sig_path)))
  sub_obj   <- if (length(net_genes) > 0) subset_eset_genes(sub_cells, net_genes) else sub_cells
  
  # Compute activity with TF+SIG (both required)
  act <- tryCatch({
    getActivity_individual(
      input_eset       = sub_obj,
      network_file.tf  = tf_path,
      network_file.sig = sig_path,
      driver_type      = "TF_SIG"
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("getActivity_individual failed for '%s': %s", subtype, e$message))
    NULL
  })
  
  activity_list[[subtype]] <- act
}

## Optional: drop NULLs
activity_list <- activity_list[!vapply(activity_list, is.null, logical(1))]

## Save:
save(activity_list, file = "rda/activity_list_TF_SIG.rda")

## Heatmap individual
for (subtype in names(activity_list)) {
  activity_matrix <- Biobase::exprs(activity_list[[subtype]])
  
  top_tfs <- head(rownames(activity_matrix[order(rowMeans(activity_matrix), decreasing = TRUE), ]), 50)
  
  pheatmap(activity_matrix[top_tfs, ],
           scale = "row",
           show_rownames = TRUE,
           show_colnames = FALSE,
           clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
           clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
           main = paste("Top TF Activity -", subtype))
}

## Finding shared TFs
common_tfs <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  lapply(activity_list, function(x) rownames(Biobase::exprs(x)))
)

combined_activity <- do.call(
  cbind,
  lapply(activity_list, function(x) {
    mat <- Biobase::exprs(x)
    mat[common_tfs, , drop = FALSE]
  })
)

combined_activity <- do.call(
  cbind,
  lapply(names(activity_list), function(subtype) {
    mat <- Biobase::exprs(activity_list[[subtype]])
    mat <- mat[common_tfs, , drop = FALSE]
    
    colnames(mat) <- paste(subtype, colnames(mat), sep = "_")
    mat
  })
)

## Heatmap combined
group_labels <- rep(names(activity_list), times = sapply(activity_list, function(x) ncol(Biobase::exprs(x))))

# Optional: filter top TFs across all
top_tfs <- head(rownames(combined_activity[order(rowMeans(combined_activity), decreasing = TRUE), ]), 50)

pheatmap(combined_activity[top_tfs, ],
         scale = "row",
         annotation_col = data.frame(Subtype = factor(group_labels)),
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         main = "Top TF Activity Across All Subtypes")

lapply(names(activity_list), function(subtype) {
  mat <- Biobase::exprs(activity_list[[subtype]])
  
  write.csv(
    mat,
    file = file.path("csv/", paste0("activity_", subtype, ".csv")),
    row.names = TRUE
  )
})

rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

